definitions.gloss: creator; creative artist; originator of creative work
definitions.explanation: A person who creates original works, particularly in literature, art, music, or other creative fields. Emphasizes the act of original creation rather than mere production.

examples.japanese: {創作者|そうさくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: To protect the rights of creators.

examples.japanese: AI⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{創作者|そうさくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Even in the age of AI, the role of creators remains unchanged.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧{創作者|そうさくしゃ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This exhibition showcases new forms of expression by young creators.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{創作|そうさく}→創作：04386_sousaku⟧ (creative work; creation) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The emphasis is on originality and creative imagination, distinguishing it from words like {製作者|せいさくしゃ} (producer/manufacturer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧{創作者|そうさくしゃ}: young creator
- {創作者|そうさくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧: creator's rights
- {創作者|そうさくしゃ}⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: support for creators
- {創作者|そうさくしゃ}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: from the creator's perspective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧: author; writer — focuses on a specific finished work
- {製作者|せいさくしゃ}: producer; manufacturer — emphasizes the production process rather than creative originality
- ⟦クリエイター→クリエイター：10871_kurieitaa⟧: creator — the English loanword, commonly used in digital and media industries
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: writer; novelist — specifically a professional writer of literature
